title: Prove consumer compatibility at release
when: Authoring a producer contract item or diagnosing a failed release pair
need: Use the existing configured release-time exact-pair gate. Do not generate a separate consumer-build requirement before each item merge or a verification-only companion. The release gate proves both commits before tagging. On failure, inspect its producer item references and commit interval with the failed consumer job; real consumer code changes still need their linked companion.
surface: AC authoring instructions, release refusal and consumer-proof guide
review: Candidate source tests cover history attribution; actual release execution is not claimed.
